name: cc-slack
description: Post, reply, react, and read Slack threads through a shared Slack app as <display name> (<agent>), and receive thread replies and DM steering in the running session through the cc-slack channel.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("cc-slack@cc-slack")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("cc-slack: the cc-slack@cc-slack plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "cc-slack")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
